title: Skill$^{\infty}$: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Skill Optimization
title_zh: Skill∞：面向智能体技能优化的递归自我改进

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI), in which a system also improves the way it improves, is a long-standing aspiration on the path to AGI. Language agents increasingly store procedural knowledge in reusable skills. Optimizing skills offers a direct way to achieve RSI, because the optimization procedure itself can be encoded as a skill. Existing skill optimizers, however, follow a hand-designed procedure. Even methods that evolve a meta-skill confine it to a fixed pipeline and relearn it for each task. We present Skill ∞ \infty , which makes skill optimization recursively self-improving: a meta agent follows a meta-skill to optimize task skills and optimizes the meta-skill itself using the same procedure. The optimization is agent-led. The meta agent diagnoses execution traces, proposes candidates, requests independent reviews, and allocates the search budget. The meta-skill defines these steps, allowing self-improvement to rewrite them. This meta-skill is also decoupled from task skills, refined on multiple skill optimization tasks and then reused to optimize task skills across diverse domains. As in deployment, skills at both levels are standard packages loaded through native skill discovery. On 83 SkillsBench tasks, Skill ∞ \infty reaches a pass rate of 60.7%, compared with 56.4% for human-curated skills and 54.5% for SkillEvolver.

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) refers to a system that improves not only its performance on tasks but also the procedure that produces these improvements ( Yudkowsky, 2007 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . Because each gain can then accelerate the next, RSI has figured prominently in visions of artificial general intelligence (AGI), from the intelligence explosion envisioned by Good (1966) to Gödel machines ( Schmidhuber, 2003 ) . More recently, skills have emerged as a common format for capturing the reusable procedural knowledge of language agents ( Anthropic, 2025b ) . This format can also encode the procedure that optimizes skills. Skills can thus encode both the target of improvement and the procedure that improves it, making skill optimization a direct and interpretable way to achieve RSI. Skills also serve as a harness-agnostic medium for RSI, since Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2025a ) , Codex ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , and OpenCode ( Anomaly, 2025 ) all load them through the same open specification ( Agent Skills, 2025 ) . To realize this potential, skill optimization must improve not only skills but also the procedure that optimizes them.

paragraphs.en: Recent approaches such as SkillOpt ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , CoEvoSkills ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , and SkillEvolver ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) already optimize skills from execution feedback. Despite differences in what they edit and how they verify candidates, these methods share one design choice. The optimizer follows a hand-designed procedure, and what it learns while optimizing one skill does not transfer to the next. MetaSkill-Evolve ( Wang et al., 2026b ) goes a step further: each search branch carries a meta-skill that configures the five agents of its pipeline, and the same pipeline refines this meta-skill. However, the pipeline’s roles and wiring remain fixed, and each meta-skill is bound to the task skill it evolves with. Some methods also optimize skills in a setting that differs from deployment ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . They inject the skill or prompt the agent to load it, so optimization never tests whether the agent would load the skill on its own.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的方法，如 SkillOpt（Yang et al., 2026）、CoEvoSkills（Zhang et al., 2026b）和 SkillEvolver（Zhang et al., 2026a），已经能够根据执行反馈优化技能。 尽管这些方法在编辑对象和候选验证方式上有所不同，但它们共享同一个设计选择。 优化器遵循人工设计的流程，而且它在优化某一技能时所学到的东西并不能迁移到下一个技能。 MetaSkill-Evolve（Wang et al., 2026b）更进一步：每个搜索分支都携带一个元技能，用于配置其流水线中的五个智能体，并且同一条流水线会对该元技能进行优化。 然而，流水线的角色和连接方式保持固定，且每个元技能都与它共同演化的任务技能绑定在一起。 一些方法在优化技能时所处的设定也与部署时的设定不同（Yang et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b）。 这些方法要么直接注入技能，要么提示智能体去加载技能，因此优化过程从未检验智能体是否会自行加载该技能。

paragraphs.en: We believe that an optimizer that improves skills but not its own procedure will eventually stagnate. RSI targets exactly this limitation. In this work, we propose Skill ∞ \infty , a framework for recursively self-improving skill optimization. A meta agent follows a meta-skill to optimize task skills and applies the same procedure to the meta-skill itself . The “ ∞ \infty ” in Skill ∞ \infty stands for two loops that meet at the meta-skill and feed into each other, as illustrated in Figure 1 . Optimization in Skill ∞ \infty is agent-led : in each iteration, the meta agent diagnoses the parent skill from execution traces, proposes and evaluates candidates within the search budget, submits each candidate to an independent reviewer, and selects the next parent. Self-improvement of the meta-skill refines this procedure, which in turn optimizes task skills more effectively. We further decouple the meta-skill from task skills. The meta-skill is refined on a set of skill optimization tasks and then reused to optimize diverse task skills. This decoupling amortizes the cost of self-improvement over task skill optimization. Skills at both levels are also provided to agents through native skill discovery , as in deployment. We neither inject a skill nor prompt an agent to load one. Agents see only a skill’s name and description and decide whether to load it. The description is therefore also included in the scope of optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，一个只能改进技能却无法改进自身流程的优化器终将陷入停滞。 RSI（递归自我改进）正是针对这一局限。 在本工作中，我们提出 Skill ∞ \infty，一个用于递归自我改进的技能优化框架。 一个元智能体遵循元技能来优化任务技能，并将同样的流程应用于元技能本身。 Skill ∞ \infty 中的「∞ \infty」代表两个在元技能处交汇并相互哺育的循环，如图 1 所示。 Skill ∞ \infty 中的优化由智能体主导：在每次迭代中，元智能体从执行轨迹中诊断父技能，在搜索预算内提出并评估候选技能，将每个候选技能提交给独立的审查者，并选出下一个父技能。 元技能的自我改进会完善这一流程，而完善后的流程又能更有效地优化任务技能。 我们进一步将元技能与任务技能解耦。 元技能在一组技能优化任务上进行改进，然后被复用于优化多样化的任务技能。 这种解耦将自我改进的成本摊销到任务技能优化之上。 两个层级的技能也都通过原生技能发现提供给智能体，与部署时一致。 我们既不注入技能，也不通过提示让智能体加载技能。 智能体只会看到技能的名称和描述，并自行决定是否加载它。 因此，描述也被纳入优化的范围之内。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Skill ∞ \infty on 83 agentic tasks from SkillsBench ( Li et al., 2026a ) , spanning eight domains, and on GPU kernel optimization from KernelBench ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) . In the main comparison, all methods share the Codex CLI ( OpenAI, 2025 ) as the harness and GPT-6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026b ) as the backbone model. On SkillsBench, Skill ∞ \infty reaches a pass rate of 60.7%, compared with 56.4% for human-curated skills and 54.5% for SkillEvolver, and on KernelBench it reaches a mean speedup of 1.62. Without the self-improvement of the meta-skill, the pass rate falls to 55.9%. Skill ∞ \infty still outperforms human-curated skills when the backbone model or the harness is replaced. Case studies in Appendix C show that self-improvement changes how the meta agent acts, not only the wording of its instructions.

paragraphs.en: The idea of RSI dates back to the argument for an intelligence explosion ( Good, 1966 ) . Gödel machines ( Schmidhuber, 2003 ) later formalized it as a program that rewrites its own code once a rewrite is proven useful. Long a vision of AGI, RSI has since been partly realized in agents built on language models. STOP ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ) runs a code-improving scaffold on its own code but notes that this is not full RSI, because the language model itself is not altered. Research on self-evolving agents ( Gao et al., 2026 ) has introduced systems that rewrite their own logic or code ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026a ) or search over agent designs ( Hu et al., 2025 ) . More recent systems make the meta-level modification procedure itself editable ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) or compose data, harness, and model updates ( Tan et al., 2026 ) . R 2 Flow ( Zhang et al., 2026e ) trains a policy that orchestrates a skill library and commits verified edits to it. These systems implement the optimizer as a program or a trained policy. Skill ∞ \infty , however, encodes the optimizer’s procedure as a skill, which makes its recursive self-improvement direct, interpretable, and harness-agnostic.
paragraphs.zh: RSI 的思想可以追溯到关于智能爆炸的论证（Good, 1966）。 哥德尔机（Gödel machines）（Schmidhuber, 2003）后来将其形式化为一种程序：一旦证明某次改写是有用的，它就会重写自己的代码。 作为 AGI 的长期愿景，RSI 此后已在基于语言模型构建的智能体中得到部分实现。 STOP（Zelikman et al., 2024）在自己的代码上运行一个代码改进脚手架，但指出这并非完整的 RSI，因为语言模型本身并未被改变。 关于自进化智能体的研究（Gao et al., 2026）已引入了一些系统，它们会重写自身的逻辑或代码（Yin et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026c；Wang et al., 2026a），或在智能体设计上进行搜索（Hu et al., 2025）。 更新的系统使元层面的修改过程本身可被编辑（Zhang et al., 2026d），或将数据、脚手架与模型更新组合起来（Tan et al., 2026）。 R²Flow（Zhang et al., 2026e）训练一个策略来编排技能库，并向技能库提交经过验证的修改。 这些系统将优化器实现为程序或训练出的策略。 然而，Skill∞ 将优化器的过程编码为一种技能，这使其递归自我改进变得直接、可解释，且与脚手架无关。

paragraphs.en: Agent skills package reusable procedures as portable directories that agents load on demand ( Anthropic, 2025b ; Agent Skills, 2025 ; Xu and Yan, 2026 ) . This format has precedents in skill libraries, induced workflows, and programmatic web skills ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) . A growing line of work learns skills from experience ( Ni et al., 2026 ; Xia et al., 2026 ) or optimizes them from execution feedback ( Alzubi et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026b ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Feng et al., 2026 ) . SkillEvolver ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) writes its optimization procedure as a fixed meta-skill that audits candidate skills in separate agents. Some methods go further and operate at the meta level, evolving meta-skills that guide skill optimization ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ) , multi-agent system design ( Lin et al., 2026a ) , or context engineering ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . These methods still evolve the meta-skill with a hand-designed procedure. MetaSkill-Evolve ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , for instance, fixes the roles and wiring of its five-agent pipeline and binds each meta-skill to the task skill it evolves with. Skill ∞ \infty instead writes an agent-led optimization procedure into the meta-skill and refines it through self-improvement on several skill optimization tasks. Decoupled from task skills, the same meta-skill then optimizes diverse task skills.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体技能（Agent skills）将可复用的流程打包为可移植的目录，智能体可以按需加载（Anthropic, 2025b; Agent Skills, 2025; Xu and Yan, 2026）。 这一格式在技能库、归纳式工作流以及程序化网络技能中有先例（Wang et al., 2024; Wang et al., 2025b; Wang et al., 2025a; Zheng et al., 2025）。 越来越多的工作从经验中学习技能（Ni et al., 2026; Xia et al., 2026），或根据执行反馈对技能进行优化（Alzubi et al., 2026; Yang et al., 2026; Lin et al., 2026b; Tian et al., 2026; Zhang et al., 2026b; Feng et al., 2026）。 SkillEvolver（Zhang et al., 2026a）将其优化流程写成一个固定的元技能（meta-skill），由独立的智能体对候选技能进行审查。 一些方法更进一步，在元层面运作，演化出用于指导技能优化的元技能（Wang et al., 2026b; Li et al., 2026b）、多智能体系统设计（Lin et al., 2026a）或上下文工程（Ye et al., 2026）。 这些方法仍然使用人工设计的流程来演化元技能。 例如，MetaSkill-Evolve（Wang et al., 2026b）固定了其五智能体流水线的角色与连接方式，并将每个元技能与它所演化的任务技能绑定在一起。 Skill ∞ \infty 则改为将一个由智能体主导的优化流程写入元技能，并通过在多个技能优化任务上的自我改进来对其进行精炼。 由于与任务技能解耦，同一元技能随后可以优化多样的任务技能。

paragraphs.en: Skill optimization builds on prompt optimization. Early methods select instructions that a language model proposes ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) or evolve populations of prompts ( Guo et al., 2024 ; Fernando et al., 2024 ) . Subsequent methods optimize compound systems of model calls ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2025 ; Khattab et al., 2024 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ) , accumulate strategies in evolving contexts ( Suzgun et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026f ) , or meta-learn system prompts that transfer across tasks ( Choi et al., 2025 ; Tao et al., 2026 ) . These methods optimize text that the surrounding system inserts into the model’s context. By contrast, Skill ∞ \infty optimizes skills, which bundle executable scripts and reference files, are loaded only when the agent judges them useful, and can even package the procedure that optimizes them.

paragraphs.en: We first formalize skills, native skill discovery, and task skill optimization by a meta-skill. We then make the meta-skill an optimization target in its own right, so that a single agent-led procedure optimizes task skills and the meta-skill alike. Finally, we decouple the meta-skill from task skills and extend native skill discovery to both levels.

paragraphs.en: We adopt the Agent Skills specification ( Agent Skills, 2025 ) , an open format through which agents across harnesses share reusable procedural knowledge. A skill package is a directory built around the SKILL.md file. The front matter of SKILL.md declares the skill’s name and description, while the body holds the instructions. The package may also bundle scripts, reference files, and other resources that the instructions invoke or cite. With these resources, a skill can provide executable procedures and detailed conventions in addition to textual guidance. An agent loads skills in stages, following a design principle known as progressive disclosure ( Anthropic, 2025b ) . Initially, it sees only the name and description of each installed skill. For a skill it judges useful for the current task, it then loads the full instructions and opens the bundled resources as needed. A skill thus takes effect only when the agent activates it by loading its instructions. We term this mechanism native skill discovery because it is built into agent harnesses and underlies skill use during deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用 Agent Skills 规范（Agent Skills, 2025），这是一种开放格式，使跨运行环境的智能体能够共享可复用的程序性知识。 技能包是一个以 SKILL.md 文件为核心的目录。 SKILL.md 的前置元数据声明技能的名称和描述，而正文部分则存放具体指令。 该包还可以捆绑脚本、参考文件以及其他资源，供指令调用或引用。 借助这些资源，技能除了文本指导之外，还能提供可执行的流程和详细的约定。 智能体按照渐进式披露（progressive disclosure）这一设计原则，分阶段加载技能（Anthropic, 2025b）。 最初，智能体只能看到每个已安装技能的名称和描述。 对于它判断对当前任务有用的技能，随后会加载完整的指令，并按需打开捆绑的资源。 因此，技能只有在智能体通过加载其指令而激活它时才会生效。 我们将这一机制称为原生技能发现（native skill discovery），因为它内置于智能体运行环境中，并构成部署期间技能使用的基础。

paragraphs.en: When the meta-skill improves itself, it is both the procedure that the meta agent follows and the target that this procedure optimizes. The meta agent thus diagnoses and revises this procedure while following it. The revised meta-skill is then evaluated on skill optimization tasks, where the optimizations it guides reveal whether it surpasses the predecessor. Such a loop makes self-improvement recursive, since improvements to the meta-skill are self-reinforcing. Each strengthens the procedure from which further improvements arise, yielding an increasingly capable meta-skill.
paragraphs.zh: 当元技能进行自我改进时，它既是元智能体所遵循的程序，也是该程序所优化的目标。 因此，元智能体在遵循该程序的同时，也对该程序进行诊断和修订。 修订后的元技能随后在技能优化任务上进行评估，它所引导的优化结果能够揭示它是否超越了前代版本。 这样的循环使自我改进具有递归性，因为对元技能的改进是自我强化的。 每一次改进都会强化产生后续改进的程序，从而使元技能的能力不断增强。

paragraphs.en: We place the meta agent at the helm of skill optimization, following a meta-skill that is editable by self-improvement. Algorithm 1 outlines the procedure, and Figure 2 depicts one of its iterations. The meta agent first inspects the optimization history recorded in the archive. It then diagnoses the parent skill from the execution traces of its rollouts. Informed by this diagnosis, it creates one or two candidates from the parent, each justified by a proposal. The meta agent evaluates the candidates and submits each to an independent reviewer. Finally, it decides whether to continue and selects either the next parent or the optimized skill.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将元智能体置于技能优化的核心位置，遵循一条可通过自我改进进行编辑的元技能。 算法 1 概述了该流程，图 2 描绘了其中一次迭代。 元智能体首先检查存档中记录的优化历史。 随后，它根据智能体（rollout）的执行轨迹对父技能进行诊断。 基于该诊断，它从父技能创建一至两个候选技能，每个候选技能均附有一份提案作为依据。 元智能体评估这些候选技能，并将每个候选技能提交给一个独立的审阅者。 最后，它决定是否继续，并选择下一个父技能或经过优化的技能。

paragraphs.en: Agent-led optimization entrusts the search to the meta agent’s reasoning rather than to a hand-designed heuristic driven by scores. A score reveals whether a candidate improved but not why, so the meta agent interprets it in light of the diagnoses and reviews recorded in the archive. The diagnoses can uncover a promising change that the score has yet to reflect, such as a tied candidate that makes progress on the failure it targets. Much as evolutionary search retains less fit candidates to escape local optima, the meta agent can build on such candidates instead of discarding them. It may likewise keep the parent when a candidate’s gain cannot be attributed to its change, or backtrack to an earlier skill when a line of revisions stalls. Beyond choosing parents, the meta agent decides which failures to address next, redirecting the search as new evidence emerges. In sum, search becomes reasoning about the failure modes of each target skill rather than a heuristic applied to all.
paragraphs.zh: 以智能体为主导的优化将搜索托付给元智能体的推理，而非交给由分数驱动的手工设计启发式方法。 分数只能揭示某个候选方案是否有所改进，却无法说明原因，因此元智能体会结合归档中记录的诊断与评审来解读分数。 诊断可以发现分数尚未反映出的有前景的改动，例如某个平局的候选方案在其针对的失败问题上取得了进展。 正如进化搜索会保留适应度较低的候选方案以跳出局部最优，元智能体也可以在此类候选方案的基础上继续构建，而不是将其丢弃。 同样地，当候选方案的收益无法归因于其改动时，它可以保留父节点；当某条修订路径停滞不前时，也可以回溯到更早的技能。 除了选择父节点之外，元智能体还决定接下来处理哪些失败，并随着新证据的出现重新引导搜索方向。 总之，搜索变成了对每个目标技能的失败模式进行推理，而不是将一种启发式方法应用于所有情况。

paragraphs.en: Only candidates that pass an independent review are eligible for selection. The reviewer operates in an isolated context, shielded from both the meta agent’s deliberation and its partiality toward its own changes. The verdict rests solely on the parent and candidate packages, the proposal, and the supporting evidence. The reviewer rejects candidates that make no substantive change, that are never activated, or that are unusable as written. Any gain from such candidates can arise only by chance, and rejecting them prevents selection from mistaking noise for progress. For a meta-skill candidate, the reviewer further verifies that the core responsibilities of a meta-skill, including the review itself, remain intact.
paragraphs.zh: 只有通过独立评审的候选方案才有资格被选中。 评审者在一个隔离的上下文中运行，既不受元智能体（meta agent）的 deliberation 影响，也不受其对自身修改的偏袒影响。 裁决仅依据父包与候选包、提案以及支持证据。 评审者会拒绝那些没有实质性修改、从未被激活、或按原样无法使用的候选方案。 这类候选方案带来的任何收益都只能来自偶然，拒绝它们可以防止选择过程把噪声误当作进展。 对于元技能候选方案，评审者还会进一步验证元技能的核心职责——包括评审本身——是否保持完整。

paragraphs.en: The meta agent allocates the search budget itself, deciding how many candidates to create in each iteration and when to stop. The number of candidates per iteration sets the balance between exploration and exploitation. Several candidates probe alternative revisions side by side, whereas a single candidate pursues one line of revisions in depth. Across target skills, a fixed schedule would allocate the same budget regardless of how much headroom remains. The meta agent instead adapts its spending to each target skill, continuing while failures persist and stopping once the diagnosis finds little left to improve.
paragraphs.zh: 元智能体自行分配搜索预算，决定每次迭代创建多少个候选以及何时停止。 每次迭代的候选数量决定了探索与利用之间的平衡。 多个候选可以并行探索不同的修改方向，而单个候选则沿一条修改路线深入推进。 对于不同的目标技能，固定调度会分配相同的预算，而不考虑还有多少改进空间。 元智能体则会根据每个目标技能调整其投入，在失败持续存在时继续，一旦诊断发现所剩改进空间不大时就停止。

paragraphs.en: The steps of Algorithm 1 are encoded in the meta-skill rather than hard-coded, so the recursive loop of Section 3.2 can rewrite the procedure itself. Any part of the package, from the instructions to the bundled scripts, is open to revision. Freed from any predefined design space, the procedure can evolve beyond the foresight of human designers and realize its full potential. Self-improvement can remedy a weak step wherever it lies, even in the review and selection of candidates, which a fixed pipeline would leave untouched. Optimizing task skills reveals the shortcomings of the procedure, and each refinement in turn yields better task skills, rendering the two levels mutually reinforcing. To keep the mutual reinforcement genuine, scoring lies beyond the reach of self-improvement, so gains can arise only from better optimization, never from reward tampering.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 的步骤被编码在元技能中而非硬编码，因此 3.2 节的递归循环可以重写该过程本身。 该包的任何部分，从指令到附带的脚本，都可以修改。 摆脱任何预定义的设计空间后，该过程可以超越人类设计者的预见而演化，充分发挥其潜力。 自我改进可以补救薄弱环节，无论其位于何处，即使是在候选的评审与选择环节，而固定流水线不会触及这些环节。 优化任务技能会暴露该过程的缺陷，而每一次改进又会带来更好的任务技能，使两个层面相互促进。 为了保持这种相互促进的真实性，评分不受自我改进的影响，因此收益只能来自更好的优化，绝不会来自篡改奖励。

The meta agent first refines a seed meta-skill m 0 m_{0} into m ⋆ m^{\star} on a set of skill optimization tasks Q Q drawn from different domains. Each candidate meta-skill is scored by Equation 3 on the inner optimizations it guides, one for each q ∈ Q q\in Q within the inner budget B q B_{q} . paragraphs.en: SkillsBench quantifies how much skills improve agent performance across diverse agentic tasks by pairing each task with human-curated skills. We optimize task skills on the dataset released with SkillEvolver ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) and test them on its 83 SkillsBench tasks from eight domains. KernelBench challenges an agent to replace a PyTorch reference model with a faster implementation that computes the same outputs. Following SkillEvolver, we optimize one task skill shared across three level-3 problems whose reference models are a deep narrow MLP, ShuffleNet, and a GRU.

paragraphs.en: Our main comparison asks whether automatically optimized skills can rival those curated by humans. Table 1 reports pass rates on SkillsBench, overall and per domain. Skill ∞ \infty attains the highest overall pass rate, 60.7%, surpassing both human-curated skills (56.4%) and SkillEvolver (54.5%). By contrast, SkillCreator (48.0%) and self-generated skills (42.9%) remain close to the agent without a skill (45.5%). paragraphs.en: Self-improvement refines the procedure that subsequently optimizes task skills. To quantify its contribution, we replace the refined meta-skill with its seed and report the result as Skill ∞ \infty w/o self-improvement in Table 1 . Even with the seed meta-skill, Skill ∞ \infty reaches an overall pass rate of 55.9%, which is higher than those of SkillEvolver and the other automatic baselines. The refined meta-skill improves the pass rate further to 60.7%. Self-improvement helps most in mathematics, media, and software engineering, by 24.0, 22.2, and 11.4 points, respectively. We attribute these gains to a stricter standard of evidence that self-improvement wrote into the meta-skill. The refined meta-skill confirms a fix only when the candidate’s rollout shows progress on the targeted failure, not when the revised skill merely mentions it. paragraphs.en: Skill optimizers have so far followed hand-designed procedures. Even methods that evolve a meta-skill fix the pipeline around it and relearn it for each task. We presented Skill ∞ \infty , which makes skill optimization recursively self-improving. A meta agent follows a meta-skill to optimize task skills, and the same agent-led procedure optimizes the meta-skill itself. The meta-skill, decoupled from task skills, is refined on skill optimization tasks and then reused to optimize task skills across domains. At both levels, agents load their skills through native skill discovery, as in deployment. On SkillsBench, Skill ∞ \infty outperforms human-curated skills and SkillEvolver, and it improves kernel speedups on KernelBench. Encoding the optimizer’s procedure as a skill makes recursive self-improvement direct, interpretable, and harness-agnostic. We hope that this view invites further work on agents that improve the way they improve.

paragraphs.en: Finally, agent-led optimization trades enforcement for flexibility. The meta agent follows its procedure rather than executing it as code. paragraphs.en: During self-improvement, the meta agent diagnosed the seed meta-skill from the inner optimizations it had guided. For the 3D scene task, the inner optimization had accepted two consecutive candidates while the verifier still reported the same link-geometry failure. It had also selected the second candidate, which only tied the parent. The meta agent located this weakness in the inspection and selection of evaluated candidates rather than in diagnosis. The candidate meta-skill it wrote requires checking the rollout of each tied or worse candidate for the targeted failure. A tied candidate can then be selected only when that rollout shows progress. The candidate improved the meta score from 0.55 to 0.83.

paragraphs.en: In the next iteration, the meta agent followed this candidate and proposed a further change that tracks intermediate scores and verifier failures across candidates. paragraphs.en: For a SkillsBench task that exports the parts of a Three.js scene as OBJ files, the seed task skill fails all test trials. In the first iteration, a rollout of the seed showed that each individual mesh passed while a merged link file failed the verifier’s geometry check. It added an exporter script, wrote the ownership and transform rules into SKILL.md , and rewrote the description to specify the files the skill produces. Its proposal states a falsifying outcome in terms of the verifier’s check. The reviewer confirmed that the script exists and matches the documented interface before accepting the candidate.
